issue: Last dose date 2013-03-05 is 13 days before the subject-withdrawal/final visit on 2013-03-18, and no adverse event, action taken or disposition record explains the earlier stop of study drug.
query_text: The record shows a last dose of study drug on 2013-03-05, two days after the Week 2 visit (2013-03-03). The subject's withdrawal ("TOO MUCH TROUBLE FOR CAREGIVER") and final lab visit are both recorded at Week 4 on 2013-03-18. The only adverse event (sinus bradycardia, 2013-03-18) has no action taken recorded. Please confirm the last dose date of 2013-03-05 is correct. If it is, please say why study drug stopped about 13 days before the withdrawal date, and whether the disposition date or reason should be updated. If it is not, please correct the exposure end date.
